trace.final_message: I added the absence notice function and its tests. The suite passes (30 tests), the lint check is clean, and the work is committed. The new function takes a student and their marks and raises an error if any mark belongs to a different student or if there are no absences. Otherwise it returns a one-line notice with the student's name, the number of days missed, and the absent dates in order. Excused and late days are not counted, because the existing absence logic leaves them out. The tests cover date ordering, the one-day wording, marks from another student, and no absences.

after.rosterkit/notices.py:
"""Plain text absence notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable

from rosterkit.attendance import days_missed
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student


def absence_notice(
    student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]
) -> str:
    """Write a short notice of the days a student missed.

    Raises ProjectError if a mark belongs to another student
    or if there are no absences to report.
    """
    marks = list(marks)
    # reject marks that belong to someone else
    for mark in marks:
        if mark.student_id != student.student_id:
            raise ProjectError(
                f"mark for {mark.student_id!r} does not "
                f"belong to {student.student_id!r}"
            )
    days = days_missed(marks)
    if not days:
        raise ProjectError(
            f"no absences for {student.student_id!r}"
        )
    count = len(days)
    unit = "day" if count == 1 else "days"
    listed = ", ".join(map(str, days))
    name = f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name}"
    return (
        f"Dear parent or guardian, {name} missed "
        f"{count} {unit} of class: {listed}."
    )
after.tests/test_notices.py:
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice

STUDENT = Student("7", "Lopez", "Ana", "A")


def mark(when, status, owner="7"):
    return Mark(owner, when, status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_dates_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            mark(date(2026, 9, 10), "absent"),
            mark(date(2026, 9, 2), "absent"),
            mark(date(2026, 9, 5), "present"),
            mark(date(2026, 9, 6), "excused"),
        ]
        text = absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        self.assertIn("Ana Lopez", text)
        self.assertIn("2 days", text)
        self.assertIn("2026-09-02, 2026-09-10", text)

    def test_single_day(self):
        marks = [mark(date(2026, 9, 2), "absent")]
        text = absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        self.assertIn("1 day ", text)

    def test_other_student(self):
        marks = [
            mark(date(2026, 9, 2), "absent"),
            mark(date(2026, 9, 3), "absent", owner="8"),
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        marks = [mark(date(2026, 9, 2), "late")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
